title: Двор под холмом

words.ex: Welcome to the Court of Thorns.
At the end of the hall stood a throne.
The hall was full of light and music.
words.ex_ru: Зал был полон света и музыки.

words.ex: The guards near the throne did not move.
Beautiful fae were dancing, laughing and whispering.
words.ex_ru: Прекрасные фейри танцевали, смеялись и шептались.

words.ex: Someone was going to betray someone.

story: On the first night, the stranger took Mira through the forest to a hill covered in white flowers. He touched the grass, and a door opened in the hill.
“Welcome to the Court of Thorns,” he said. “Smile, but trust no one. Not even me.”
“Do I at least get your name?” Mira asked.
“You can call me Ash.” It was not his real name. She knew that.
Inside, the hall was full of light and music. Beautiful fae were dancing, laughing and whispering. Everyone was watching Mira. A mortal girl in a simple dress — she was something new.
At the end of the hall stood a throne made of black wood and roses. A tall fae with a golden crown sat on it. His eyes were silver too.
“My brother, Prince Corin,” Ash said quietly. “Bow.”
Mira bowed. The guards near the throne did not move, but their hands were on their swords.
“Brother,” said Corin with a cold smile. “You brought a pet.”
“Friends are dangerous here. They become enemies so easily.”
Later that night, a young fae girl with green hair came to Mira's room. “I am Lirra,” she whispered. “I serve Prince Corin, but I hate him. I can help you.”
Mira wanted to trust her. She really did. But she remembered Ash's words, and she said nothing about the iron ring.
Somewhere in this court, someone was going to betray someone. Mira only hoped it would not be her.

questions.q: How did Ash open the door to the court?
Why did Mira say nothing about the ring?

grammar.title: Длительное прошедшее: was / were + -ing
grammar.text:
Когда действие шло в какой-то момент в прошлом, используют was / were + глагол с -ing: fae were dancing — «фейри танцевали» (в тот момент), everyone was watching Mira — «все смотрели на Миру».

Сравни: Mira bowed — «Мира поклонилась» (одно законченное действие, Past Simple).

was going to — «собирался»: someone was going to betray someone — «кто-то собирался кого-то предать».
